propositions: Duplicate allowlisted read-only tool calls (read_file, search_files, list_directory, show_ticket) must be memoized and return cached results without re-executing the wrapped tool function
Error-prefixed result strings (indicating tool failures) must not be memoized and must re-execute on identical subsequent calls, with no nudge emitted

Deterministic sentinel-empty results like '(no matches)' must be memoized and carry escalating static nudges (level-1 on first repeat, level-2 thereafter) to steer the model away from pathological loops
The runaway guard wrapper must remain outermost and observe all memoized duplicates for distinct-ratio calculation, preserving existing abort semantics
Memo and nudge implementation must be closure-scoped and thread-safe (asyncio.Lock per signature) to handle concurrent tool-call batches within a single turn
Live Bedrock capture must demonstrate a nudge-broken loop or nudge-to-actuator escalation with recorded usage-log figures and durable artifact under docs/experiments/
